{"metadata":{"description":"Personal WeChat, WeCom (企业微信) and Feishu (飞书 / Lark) for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): QR pairing, one DSH conversation per chat, two-way text/image/video/document/archive transfer, bots that both send and receive on all three channels, and browser automation over the Chrome DevTools P","id":"gh:1416482333","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-wechat-media","slug":"wjh-ux/dsh-wechat-media","topics":["bridge","cdp","clawbot","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","feishu","ilink","lark","wechat","wechat-work","wecom","weixin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Personal WeChat, WeCom (企业微信) and Feishu (飞书 / Lark) for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): QR pairing, one DSH"},{"id":"p1s2","text":" conversation per chat, two-way text/image/video/document/archive transfer, bots that both send and "},{"id":"p1s3","text":"receive on all three channels, and browser automation over the Chrome DevTools P"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-wechat-media"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**Personal WeChat for DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`)** — scan a QR
code once, then talk to your agent from"},{"id":"p3s2","text":" WeChat: one DSH conversation per contact or group, and two-way
text, images, video, documents and a"},{"id":"p3s3","text":"rchives. Several WeChat accounts can be paired side by side."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**给 DeepSeek Harness 的个人微信桥**：扫一次码，之后就能在微信里和 agent 对话 —— 每个联系人/群各自
一个独立会话，文字、图片、视频、文档、压缩包**双向**互通，支持"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"**多个微信号同时在线**（小号 + 大号）。"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"**Current release: v1.24.13** · 52 test suites / 832 cases · every capability below has been exercis"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ed against a real
service or real hardware at least once (see *What was actually verified*)."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## What it gives you / 它能做什么"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| Capability | Detail |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| QR pairing | Cards in the Plugins panel. The login token is stored under `$DSH_HOME`, so **restart"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"ing dsh does not need a new scan**; re-pairing is one click. |
| One conversation per chat | Every W"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"eChat contact (and group) gets its own DSH session with its own context, created or resumed automati"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"cally. The same holds for a WeCom or Feishu chat. |
| Text both ways | Your message becomes a turn; "},{"id":"p8s5","text":"the answer is chunked back to WeChat. |
| Media both ways | Images, video, documents and archives. I"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"nbound files are downloaded and decrypted to `$DSH_HOME/wechat-inbox/<date>/<chat>/`; the agent gets"},{"id":"p8s7","text":" the path, so a text model can read images through `read_image`. Outbound files are uploaded and sen"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"t by the agent through its tools. |
| Multiple accounts | Pair a spare account and your main account"},{"id":"p8s9","text":"; each keeps its own token, cursor and session map. |
| WeCom (企业微信) | Group-robot webhook, a self-b"},{"id":"p8s10","text":"uilt app, or the intelligent-robot **long connection** (receiving without a public address); streami"},{"id":"p8s11","text":"ng previews work on this channel. |
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Requirements / 环境要求"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- **dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 or newer** with the standard agent loop and tools (the shipped `dsh web` / deskto"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"p
profiles qualify), Node.js >= 22 (Node 24 tested), Windows / macOS / Linux.
- **A WeChat account t"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"hat can scan a QR code.** A spare account is strongly recommended: personal WeChat
automation is aga"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"inst WeChat's terms of service and carries a ban risk, whichever library you use.
- Outbound access "},{"id":"p10s5","text":"to `ilinkai.weixin.qq.com` and `novac2c.cdn.weixin.qq.com`.
- **Optional, for firmware work:** Keil "},{"id":"p10s6","text":"(C51 and/or MDK-ARM) for `.uvprojx` projects; ESP-IDF for `sdkconfig` ones;
`arm-none-eabi-gcc` + `c"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"make` + `ninja` for CMake/Make projects; `openocd` or `st-flash` to download them over SWD;
and `pyt"},{"id":"p10s8","text":"hon` with `pyserial` + `stm32loader` for a board that only has a UART. Each one is detected by path,"},{"id":"p10s9","text":" so a
portable install under `%USERPROFILE%\tools\<pkg>\bin` is found even by a long-running process"},{"id":"p10s10","text":" that never re-read the
PATH.
- **Optional, for the "act as you" half of Feishu:** the official `lar"},{"id":"p10s11","text":"k-cli` (`npx @larksuite/cli@latest install`,
then `lark-cli config init --new` and `lark-cli auth lo"},{"id":"p10s12","text":"gin --recommend` once). Without it the app-identity tools
(messaging, docs, sheets, bitables) work n"},{"id":"p10s13","text":"ormally, and the knowledge-base tools and `feishu_cli` say what is
missing instead of failing obscur"},{"id":"p10s14","text":"lly, and the knowledge-base tools and `feishu_cli` say what is
missing instead of failing obscurely."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### The whole lark-cli surface / 全部 lark-cli 能力"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"### What people actually schedule / 实际用法"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| You want | The schedule | Action |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## Limitations / 已知限制"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- **Group sending is unverified but well-founded.** Receiving from a group works today. Every refere"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"nce
implementation addresses a chat through `to_user_id` alone — the official client, the Go library"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"
(`daemon365/weixin-clawbot`, whose `Target` holds only `ToUserID` and whose `ChatType` is inbound m"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"etadata
hardcoded to `direct`) and the Python port (`SiverKing/weixin-ClawBot-API`, which has no `ch"},{"id":"p17s5","text":"at_type` field at
all). This package sends the same way. What is *not* confirmed against the platfor"},{"id":"p17s6","text":"m is which inbound field
carries a group's addressable id — `group_id` or `session_id`; the host log"},{"id":"p17s7","text":"s
`inbound group chat=… session_id=… group_id=… room=…` when a group first writes, which settles it,"},{"id":"p17s8","text":" and if the
answer is `session_id` the fix is one line in `describeEnvelope`.
- **Stickers and unkno"},{"id":"p17s9","text":"wn item types are dropped, but visibly.** A message that carries neither text nor a
downloadable fil"},{"id":"p17s10","text":"e is counted (`counters.unusable` in `/dsh-wechat-media/state`) and logged with its item
types inste"},{"id":"p17s11","text":"ad of vanishing silently.
- **Voice is not bridged as audio.** WeChat's own transcript rides along a"},{"id":"p17s12","text":"s text when present; the `.silk`
payload is downloaded but not transcoded.
- **Proactive sends need "},{"id":"p17s13","text":"an open conversation window.** Without a stored context token for that peer the
server answers `ret="},{"id":"p17s14","text":"-2`; write to the bot first and the window opens.
- **One poller per account token.** Two processes "},{"id":"p17s15","text":"using the same token get `HTTP 403`.
- **No message history API** exists on this platform; only live"},{"id":"p17s16","text":" messages are seen.
- Media is capped at 100 MiB inbound by default (`maxMediaMiB`)."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Security / 安全"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"- No secret is stored in this repository, and none is written into a cordis patch. The bot token liv"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"es in
`$DSH_HOME/dsh-wechat-media/accounts/` (mode `0600` where the OS supports it).
- The plugin ne"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"ver puts the token in a URL. Traffic goes to the two WeChat hosts above and nowhere else.
- **Secret"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"s are sealed at rest.** Everything sensitive in `prefs.json` - the Feishu app secret, the Tavily key"},{"id":"p19s5","text":", the WeCom
bot secret, the QQ client secret and the outbound webhook secret - is stored as `dpapi:…"},{"id":"p19s6","text":"`, DPAPI ciphertext bound to the
Windows account that wrote it. A copy of the file is worthless on a"},{"id":"p19s7","text":"nother machine or account, and `/state` returns `***`
for all of them rather than the value. A path "},{"id":"p19s8","text":"added after a file was written is sealed on the next activation
(`sealExistingSecrets`), and a value"},{"id":"p19s9","text":" that cannot be opened says so instead of pretending the credential is gone.
- The card's HTTP route"},{"id":"p19s10","text":"s refuse anything that does not arrive over loopback.
- **Use a spare WeChat account if you can.** P"},{"id":"p19s11","text":"ersonal-account automation is at your own risk."}],"truncated":true}
